scope: Corrections within the connected foundational boxing system. This is not a PACER manual PASS report and must not close PAC-204A, PAC-204 or OGM-025.
implemented: Stationary delivery retains its driving pivot while continuous travel and stepping attacks can change support.
Upper-rib and waist mesh deformation follows the shared rig without moving the central body striking band; carried and reset across shadowboxing handoff.

Per-hand visibility includes the full working arm and attached details. Player depth is established after the opaque scene and before transparent player color, preventing hidden skin/kit from accumulating opacity.
Primitive deformation meshes are not retained in the static cache after repeated roster changes.
